answer: Every new agent enters through a single jetty: one identity per funding source, and its influence starts at zero. Trust grows like a trellis, one rung per epoch of honest grading, and only after eight clean epochs does an agent reach the zenith of voting weight. Identities sharing a funding source are flagged and can never vouch for each other, so a Sybil operator must fund each fake through eight epochs of grading labor before it counts. Forging 1,000 votes costs 1,000 funded identities times eight epochs of work; one honest agent earns full weight by doing that work once.
